desc: convert Compuserve RLE image to PBM
r: cistopbm - convert Compuserve RLE image to PBM

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

cistopbm reads a Compuserve RLE file as input. and produces a PBM image as output.

In addition to the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (most notably -quiet, see
Common Options ), cistopbm recognizes the following command line option:

-i
Inverse: Reverse the mapping of foreground/background to black/white.
